embedderModelName.description:
The name of the embedder model, for example "mixedbread-ai/mxbai-embed-large-v1" for HuggingFace
an MXBAI Sentence Transformer model using {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Hf} or "text-embedding-3-large"
for an Azure OpenAI hosted embedder using {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Llm}.

embedderType.description: The specific type of embedder to, for example {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Hf} or {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Llm}.

authName.description:
For cases where the embedder should use a different GenaiCore auth than the default (that is
a different {@link GenaiCore.Llm.AzureOpenAi.Auth}, {@link GenaiCore.Llm.Bedrock.Auth},
or {@link GenaiCore.Llm.VertexAi.Auth}), this is the name of the auth to use.

embedderEngineDeploySpec.description:
Optional {@link Engine.DeploySpec} to pass to {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Engine#createFromEmbedder} when deploying
a {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Hf}. If the engine is already running, this will be ignored.

By default, embedderModelName will be used for the engine name, when creating a {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Engine}.
This means that all functionality needing that model will share the same embedder engine, but for cases where
functionality requires a separate purpose-specific embedder engine, the name can be specified in the deploySpec.

providerType.description:
When using {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Llm}, the provider type to use for the embedder, for example
{@link GenaiCore.Llm.AzureOpenAi} or {@link GenaiCore.Llm.VertexAi}

hfEmbedder.description: The default fields to use when #embedderType is {@link GenaiCore.Embedder.Hf}.

title:
Spec for {@link Genai.Embedder#getEmbedder} to create a {@link GenaiCore.Embedder} for embedding text such as
queries or passages.
